title: Brandoctors Indonesia
description: Bridging the gap between official authority and digital-first audiences. I crafted a modern visual system for the Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan Republik Indonesia (BPOM RI) campaign to make public health data more accessible, relatable, and high-impact.

Executed the comprehensive visual identity for Wellfest 2025, Indonesia's premier wellness festival. I translated the 'Elevate Your Well-being' vision into over 20 high-impact digital assets and immersive on-site environmental graphics (banners & signage), creating a cohesive brand experience for over 261,000 visitors.

Spearheaded the visual narrative for HAI-FEST 2025 (Health Innovation Festival) and the 61st National Health Day. I designed cohesive assets to promote the 'Generasi Sehat' campaign, driving public awareness for the nationwide Free Health Check (CKG) program and the SATUSEHAT digital ecosystem integration.
